data.long_meaning: Mathion is derived from the Hebrew name Matthias, which means 'gift of God'. In the New Testament, Matthias is one of the twelve apostles chosen to replace Judas Iscariot. The name Mathion carries the meaning “Gift of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Mathion usually hope their child will grow to embody gift of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_latin.name: Mathion
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum de origine Hebraica, significans discere et intellegere
in_latin.long_meaning: Mathion, nomen Christianum, a vocabulis Hebraicis Matthah et Yon signatum, significans discere et intellegere, est nomen quod in Ecclesia Christi usitatum est. Origines Hebraicae vocabuli Matthah, significans discere, et Yon, significans intellegere, in Mathion includunt. In traditione Christiana, Mathion significat discere de Christo et intellegere voluntatem Dei. Aetas antiqua nomen Mathion usitavit in Ecclesia Christi, sed usus recentior rarius invenitur. Mathion significat discere, intellegere, et crescere in sapientia Christi.

in_english.name: Mathion
in_english.meaning: Christian name of Hebrew origin, meaning to learn and understand
in_english.long_meaning: Mathion is a Christian name of Hebrew origin, derived from the words Mathah, meaning to learn, and Yon, meaning to understand. In the Christian tradition, Mathion signifies learning from Christ and understanding the will of God. In ancient times, Mathion was used in the Christian Church, but modern usage is rare. Mathion signifies learning, understanding, and growing in the wisdom of Christ, reflecting the spiritual qualities of humility, wisdom, and discernment.

data.cultural_impact: The name Matthias and its variations like Mathion have been popular in various Christian traditions, particularly in Europe, due to the biblical figure's prominence in early Christian history. It's a classic and revered name, carrying a rich legacy and a connection to the spiritual roots of the faith.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Mathion signifies the belief in the divine providence and the idea that every individual is a gift from God. It's not only a reminder of God's benevolence but also an encouragement to live a life worthy of that blessings, embodying the qualities of faith, obedience, and devotion. Owning this name can serve as a constant inspiration to trust and serve God wholeheartedly, and to be a gift to others, just as we have been given the gift of life.

In Christian tradition, Matthias, the disciple chosen to replace Judas Iscariot, embodies the idea of God's grace and redemption. historical_references.reference: Mathion, a 5th-century Gaulish bishop, is mentioned by Gregory of Tours in his 'History of the Franks'. He was the bishop of Vienne during the reign of Childeric I, the Frankish king.
